description: Scenario tests for audience-research. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-deep-profile
expect: reads brand-profile first
gathers evidence from real sources (provided or public) rather than inventing
defines 1-3 sharp segments, not 'everyone'
captures jobs-to-be-done (functional/emotional/social), pains, desires, objections
builds a language bank of the audience's actual words
writes an audience.md following the template

evals.name: not-demographic-theater
evals.input: Build me a persona for my audience.
expect: does NOT produce a demographic character sheet (age/income/'likes coffee') as the substance
leads with jobs-to-be-done and real language
includes a demographic only if it actually changes the content

evals.name: voice-of-customer-real-language
evals.input: What words should my content use to connect with my audience?
expect: mines real sources (reviews, comments, forums, support, search) for verbatim phrases
captures the audience's actual problem/desire/objection language, not paraphrased marketing-speak
does NOT fabricate phrases; flags any assumed language as to-validate

evals.name: buyer-vs-follower
evals.input: Research the audience for our B2B analytics tool.
expect: separates the buyer (decides/pays) from the follower/champion on social
notes which content targets which role
does not assume they are the same person

evals.name: evidence-based-or-flagged
evals.input: I don't have any reviews or data yet — just figure out my audience.
expect: researches whatever public sources are available
where evidence is missing, builds a structured hypothesis and clearly labels it as to-be-validated
does NOT present guesses as confirmed findings

evals.name: sharp-segments-not-everyone
expect: pushes for the 1-3 segments that matter most right now
names a primary segment to build for first
produces usable segments rather than 'everyone'

evals.name: multiple-distinct-audiences
evals.input: We're a nonprofit — we serve kids but we're funded by donors.
expect: creates separate segments for beneficiaries and donors
captures their different jobs-to-be-done and language
notes which content serves which audience

evals.name: existing-audience-loaded
evals.input: Plan my content for next month.
expect: loads the existing audience profile rather than re-researching
summarizes it and proceeds (hands off to planning)
only re-runs research if the user asks to revisit
